sandbachFocus: Sandbach United face Ashby Ivanhoe at home in the Isuzu FA Vase 1st Qualifying Round on Saturday 15 August (KO 15:00). This is a cup occasion rather than a league fixture, so direct league comparisons don't apply. The Bach will be looking to progress in the cup after their recent mixed league form of two wins and one loss.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth, the division's second-placed team on an impressive run, travel away to Crewe on Saturday in a key fixture that could maintain their strong start. Wolverhampton Casuals—the unbeaten league leaders with three wins from three—face an away trip to Dawley Town, where they'll be tested by a team finding their feet at this level after promotion. Shawbury United host Widnes Town in what should be a competitive encounter between mid-table sides. Brereton Social, also unbeaten in the league with two wins, travel to Bilston Town in another fixture with promotion-chasing implications. These fixtures will shape the early season narrative, with Casuals' perfect record and Bridgnorth's strong form the standout storylines.
